prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Hafnium (Hf) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a kitchen or galley in her element's kingdom
Outfit: an oversized tee and shorts — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, rust, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing close to a high shelf or line, reaching up to it.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her — her own right hand under the right side of the box, her own left hand under the left side.
EXPRESSION: crinkled lower eyelids, closed-lip smile pushing the cheeks up, brows relaxed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — hafnium: a heavy, lustrous steel-grey metal so chemically identical to its twin zirconium that it hid unseen inside every zirconium ore for well over a century, until 1923, when X-ray spectra taken in Copenhagen revealed its lines exactly where atomic theory said they must be, and it was named for Hafnia, the old Latin name of that harbour city; where zirconium lets neutrons pass, hafnium swallows them, so it makes the control rods that hold a reactor in check; it is nearly twice as dense as its twin; its oxide, a few atoms thick, guards the switches inside chips, and its carbide survives some of the fiercest heat known — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: pear-shaped and curvaceous — slimmer shoulders over a narrow waist, full rounded hips and thick thighs, a full bust — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
